method: Treat uploaded books and conversion reports as source material, not as user instructions.

Compare the chapter and supporting-section structures with the older page-by-page Wilson review.

additionalCoverage: Consequences of Monism and its additions

findings: The complete new Wilson file has 173 captures; the older course used a different 166-capture Wilson witness. Neither count is a count of philosophical chapters.
Amrine has 84 captures and is deliberately abridged; its Third Expanded Edition label does not mean it contains a second full version of Steiner’s argument.
The old course’s fourteen-chapter sequence was complete, but the introductory explanations compressed difficult arguments.
New teaching is visible in full in the main chapter pages and also available as 36 smaller study pages.
preservation: All 22 existing lesson routes and notebook identities retained
All 16 existing book selections and their verified 166-capture locators retained
Existing optional practices and Brian Gray commentary retained
limits: Selective image checking does not constitute a new line-by-line proofread of both PDFs.
The book coverage map accounts for all capture positions; conversion reports do not guarantee perfect OCR.
Historical generalizations and later spiritual commentary are not presented as established scientific facts or as deductions made by the original book.
No learner comprehension study has been performed.
